Instructions

Preparation: Stand tall with light dumbbells at your sides and palms facing in. Keep a slight elbow bend and raise outward in a comfortable plane just in front of your shoulders. Allow natural arm and shoulder-blade rotation as you continue overhead; lower along the same arc.

1

Stand tall, weights at your sides.

2

Raise outward; keep elbows softly fixed.

3

Pass shoulder height with thumbs up.

4

Reach overhead without leaning back.

5

Lower out to shoulder height under control.

6

Lower steadily; continue to your sides.

Watch out

Use light weights, stay tall and control the full outward arc.

COMMON MISTAKES

Bending the elbows to press the weights overhead.
Leaning backward or swinging the hips to lift.
